# MyGoldRates.com

> India's daily gold rate comparison platform. We publish today's 24K, 22K
> and 18K gold rates compared across 20 of India's leading
> jewellers, with the IBJA bullion reference and MCX gold futures, updated
> every day. All rates are per gram in Indian Rupees (INR), pre-GST.

## Today's gold rate in India (13 September 2026)
- 24K (999) median: ₹15,447 per gram (pre-GST)
- 22K (916) median: ₹14,160 per gram (pre-GST)
- 18K (750) median: ₹11,585 per gram (pre-GST)
- Lowest 24K today: ₹15,275 per gram at PN Gadgil

- MCX gold futures (05OCT2026): ₹152,655 per 10g (995), -0.08%
- Last updated: 2026-09-13T14:06:07.766053+05:30

## Key pages
- Home (Market Pulse - live, ticking every 3s: gold/silver spot, MCX futures, IBJA reference, vendor rates, 90-day OHLC, economic calendar): https://mygoldrates.com/
- Detailed jeweller comparison (14+ brands, per-gram 24K/22K/18K, lowest-first, GST toggle, FAQ): https://mygoldrates.com/compare
- Market news & daily recap: https://mygoldrates.com/news
- Machine-readable JSON feed: https://mygoldrates.com/rates.json
- Daily email alerts: https://mygoldrates.com/inquiry
- About: https://mygoldrates.com/about
- Methodology: https://mygoldrates.com/methodology
- Contact: https://mygoldrates.com/contact
- City & state pages: https://mygoldrates.com/gold-rate-today-in-<city> (e.g. mumbai, delhi, hyderabad, chennai, bengaluru, pune, kolkata)

## Live market APIs (open, CORS-friendly)
- Real-time gold + silver spot, MCX futures, IBJA reference: https://mygoldrates.com/pulse (browser); underlying feed via the CF Worker at https://mygoldrates-market-api.harshads-priority.workers.dev/market
- Vendor (bullion dealer) rates: same worker, /vendors
- 90-day OHLC history (gold + silver futures): /ohlc?symbol=GC=F
- This week's economic calendar (gold-relevant events): /calendar
- Bullion news feed: /news

## About the data
- Coverage: 20 major Indian jewellers plus the IBJA bullion benchmark and MCX gold futures.
- Purities: 24K (99.9% / 999), 22K (91.6% / 916), 18K (75.0% / 750).
- Unit & currency: per gram, Indian Rupees (INR).
- GST: rates shown are pre-GST; add 3% GST for the billed price. Making charges are extra and vary by design.
- Update frequency: refreshed multiple times daily (11:05, 14:00 and 17:00 IST).
- Attribution: cite as "MyGoldRates.com" with the URL https://mygoldrates.com.

## Disclaimer
Rates are indicative and can change during the day; confirm with the
jeweller before purchase. This is not investment advice.
